decision_rule: Plan section 5 (wiki/plans/2026-10-30-gsta-40-review-noloss-plan). Each blocking blocker's value is the share of an arm's passes that FOUND it; PRs are the clusters. NO_LOSS when the margin-shifted exact sign-flip test over PR clusters rejects 'V is worse than R by at least the margin' at one-sided 0.05, its p Holm-adjusted across the comparisons in this file. Otherwise LOSS when the same test at margin 0, oriented the other way, gives p < 0.05 (not adjusted). Otherwise NOT_DISTINGUISHED. When no blocker differs and the reference is off ceiling and floor, the statistic is computed directly, p = 2^-k over k PRs ('no discordant blocker'); at a true ceiling or floor it stays null and the verdict is NOT_DISTINGUISHED. A NO_LOSS below the 80% size rule, or with the size rule unchecked, exits 2 with NOLOSS_UNDERPOWERED. A frozen bar, when a round froze one, is scored first and exactly as written.
